title: Coinbase Posts Loss as Revenue Drops for Another Quarter
summary: Coinbase Global Inc. reported a third consecutive quarterly decline in revenue, showing once again how a cooling crypto market can pressure even one of the industry’s most diversified exchanges.

title: Reddit Projects Strong Sales, But No New AI Deals

title: Chile Sends Mixed Signals on Private Capital in Codelco
summary: Chilean authorities sent mixed messages on the future of copper giant Codelco as the finance minister opened the door to private capital while the company’s chairman said it had no plans to go public.
